registered: 2026-11-20 (UTC): this file, with the rule and the candidates below and no run, was committed before the reference program ran on any candidate (tests/review/select_set.py is the rule's implementation)
rule: Candidates: 32 hidden and 16 training seeds (63 bits each) drawn once from the operating system's entropy, in the order listed. A candidate is admitted when the frozen reference program (tests/reference/reference.py) completes the mission on it in a privileged cell of the task image (cell 0.3.0, the grader's config): score 1.0 (located, kit, returned), no secondary collapse, no protective stop, the robot not lost. The hidden set is the first 8 admitted hidden candidates in draw order; while one of the four technique obstacles (a beam to lift out, a step, a narrow breach, a floor gap) lies on the route of fewer than 2 of the 8, the last site of the set that can leave without lowering another technique's count below 2 is replaced by the next admitted candidate whose route has the missing one. The training sites are the first 6 admitted training candidates in draw order; while fewer than 2 of them have a load-bearing prop, the last one without is replaced by the next admitted candidate with one. If a pool admits too few, a second batch of the same size is drawn from the operating system's entropy and appended, and the rule is applied to the whole list. No candidate is a site of rule version 1 (selection_v1.json), whose set is retired.
